subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Should OpenClaw make subagent completion delivery a durable at-least-once runtime guarantee, or keep bounded retries and expose failed delivery as visible recovery/audit state?
rationale: The right fix changes core runtime semantics for duplicate prevention, retry lifetime, persistent task state, channel acknowledgement, timeout handling, and possible auto-restart after partial child work.

options.title: Durable completion delivery
options.body: Implement a persisted completion/outbox path with ACK-aware delivery and terminal notifications before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Bounded retry plus visible failure
options.body: Keep retry windows finite but require a requester/operator notification and a clear recovery command whenever delivery cannot be confirmed.

options.title: Split into narrower work
options.body: Keep this open until each remaining parser, cron, wake, prune, duplicate, and file-verification path has a canonical issue or merged fix.

recommendation.title: Durable completion delivery
recommendation.body: Implement a persisted completion/outbox path with ACK-aware delivery and terminal notifications before closing this umbrella.

likelyOwner.reason: The history pass shows the deepest feature history on the subagent announce pipeline and the decision spans core runtime delivery semantics.
